A cinematic voice forged in shadow and fire.
Deep, resonant, and unmistakably powerful — this voice speaks with weight. Ideal for epic narrations, dark monologues, ancient villains, or timeless gods.

From the halls of forgotten empires to the edge of the abyss — this voice doesn't just speak... it commands.

mann-kalt.name: Bartholomeus - Sensual and Bold
mann-kalt.description: A middle-aged German male(volent) voice, speaking with fluttering, scrabbling tone. Voice was trained reading horror and grim dark fantasy stories. It is perfect for evil characters, sending shivers down the spine and leaving an echo of dread in its wake! Spoken by the voice actor Christoph Beck.

mann-kalt.name: Roderich - Crude & Ruthless
mann-kalt.description: Deep, gritty, gravelly villain voice with a rough, cynical tone and lawless attitude. Try periods … for laughing. Perfect for online games, real-time applications and non-player characters (NPC) like fantasy bandits, highwaymen, guards, soldiers, evil villains or ruffian bouncers. Low, raspy and menacing delivery full of punchy threats, dark humor and spontaneous, realistic breath control. Highly organic and API-integration optimized. Love this gaming-voice? Checkout other voices by Alex Vox.

mann-kalt.name: Viktor - Audiobook Narrator
mann-kalt.description: A deep, captivating German male voice for thrillers, crime stories, and audiobooks. Viktor creates genuine suspense and delivers exactly the right dynamics—ideal for audiobook narration, TTS applications, audio dramas, and dark storytelling.

monster.name: Krümel King – Cookie-loving Fun Monster
monster.description: A playful and mischievous Cookie Monster-inspired character from Sesame Street, also known as Krümelmonster in German. Perfect for Real-Time Game Playing, NPC interactions, and immersive storytelling. This character voice brings the fun, chaos, and love of cookies to life, making every scene unforgettable. Seamlessly integrate via API to add personality, humor, and charm to your digital creations. Love This Voice? Check out other Character Voices by Alex Vox!

monster.name: Azrak - Menacing Monster
monster.description: A deep, dark creature voice – demonic, authoritative & imposing, with a rugged, terrifying tone. Think dark fantasy boss meets horror antagonist: guttural, dark & full of raw power for maximum cinematic dread. Heavy, resonant & beastly, delivers intense boss fights, creature monologues, and grounded, terrifying dialogue. Built for horror games, epic cutscenes, dark fantasy, and immersive real-time gaming. Voiced by Alex Vox.

monster.name: Bartholomeus - Maximum Evil
monster.description: This is the maximum evil variant of Bartholomeus Bösewicht. A voice spoken from the abyss, warped and scarred by additional filtering for perfect rattles, scrapes and growls. Shivering between breath and breakage, it carries a predatory vibe that feels invasive and threatening. Forged in horror and grim dark fantasy - made for demons, ancient monsters, possessed narrators and figures that shouldn't exist.

monster.name: Haunting-Hector – Dark Cinematic
monster.description: A haunting, deep-pitched male voice with dark cinematic resonance and an ominous, commanding presence. Ideal for gaming NPCs, villains, monsters, antiheroes, animated characters, dark fantasy, horror, cinematic trailers, audiobooks, dramatic narration, supernatural stories, and immersive world-building. Mysterious, menacing, ancient and powerful. Voiced by Christian Plasa.

monster.name: Raging Rex - Brutal Screams & Rage
monster.description: An intense male voice built for brutal screams, aggressive shouting, rage, horror, monsters, villains, battle scenes and extreme character performances. Powerful, raw and highly expressive, suited for games, animation, trailers and dramatic sound design. Voiced by Christian Plasa

monster.name: Toby - Little Mythical Monster
monster.description: A goblin creature with a high-pitched voice. Great for animation, video games, and characters.

monster.name: Dante - Growly and Menacing Monster
monster.description: A deep, menacing voice straight from your worst nightmares. This creature growls, snarls, and speaks with eerie calm. Perfect for horror games, dark narration, boss battles, or anything that needs a voice that sounds truly otherworldly.

monster.name: Yash M – Monster Villain Character
monster.description: Yash M doesn't just sound like a villain — he sounds like the one you can't forget. His deeply unsettling, fear-inducing delivery carries the kind of menacing energy that makes listeners genuinely uncomfortable. Built for horror villain characters, dark antagonist monologues, monster voiceovers, horror game characters, and chilling audio drama roles. A natural fit for indie game developers, horror fiction creators, audio drama producers, and horror channels looking for a voice that makes their villain truly terrifying.

monster.name: Ostap - Grim Monster Hunter
monster.description: A low, grave Ukrainian male voice for dark fantasy characters: a monster hunter who warns once and never repeats himself. Quiet menace turns into a hard command within a single line. Made for games, animation, audio dramas and grim folklore scenes. Key qualities: intense, grave, commanding.

monster.name: Jerry B. - New York Italian Mobster
monster.description: This voice delivers a bold New York Italian-American male mobster voice for mafia characters, gangster dialogue, crime drama, tough guy roles, video games, animation, cinematic stories, comedy sketches, villain scenes, wiseguy narration, underworld characters, and gritty character performances. Brash, confident, streetwise, mischievous, intimidating, and full of attitude.

monster.name: Malyx - Echoey, Menacing and Deep Demon
monster.description: A Deep Demon Monster. Perfect for Video Games, Characters & Animation. Ghoul, Monster, Fantasy, Dark, Horror.

monster.name: Antonio - Grumpy Grandpa
monster.description: An elderly Italian-American male voice with a thick New York/Italian accent, fluctuating between calm nostalgia and explosive anger. The voice has a natural gruffness and commanding presence, with occasional raspy undertones when shouting. Perfect for portraying an old-school mobster character reminiscing about the past.

monster.name: Jerry B. - Dark Villain & Cinematic
monster.description: This voice delivers a deep, cinematic American male tone designed for villains, dark storytelling, trailers, and dramatic content. His delivery is powerful, gritty, intense, and commanding, making it ideal for movie trailers, horror narration, fantasy worlds, video games, dark characters, monsters, demons, and cinematic storytelling. Perfect for suspense, thriller, action, and gaming projects seeking an immersive deep voice with menace, gravitas, authority, and dramatic impact.

monster.name: Crazy Eddie
monster.description: A raspy, slightly high-pitched gangster voice with a sly, street-crook attitude. Rough, tight, and a little nasal, he sounds like a slick-talking hustler who always has a scheme. Perfect for NPC mobster and mafia characters, shady crooks, clever grifters, or a chaotic cartoon gangster in realtime gameplay. Built for API integration, dynamic NPC dialogue, and interactive game worlds. Works in English, German, and more. If you like this voice, check out other character voices by Alex Vox.

monster.name: Gabriel Blanco - Warm & Expressive
monster.description: Once upon a time, there was a voice capable of making the monsters under the bed want to hear the ending. A professional voice from Spain with a warm, approachable, and expressive tone. Perfect for children's or young adult stories, audiobooks, educational content, documentaries, emotional videos, and any story worth telling naturally.

monster.name: Jacob L. - Villain, Horror, Cinematic
monster.description:
Deep, dark and menacing male character with cinematic gravitas, gritty texture and controlled intensity. Built for villains, horror, thrillers, Halloween, haunted attractions, video games, animation, trailers, dark fantasy, supernatural characters and dramatic storytelling. Best use cases: villains, antagonists, monsters, evil masterminds, scary stories, gothic scenes and immersive cinematic narration. 
Key qualities: deep, sinister, authoritative, menacing, gritty, dramatic and ominous.

monster.name: Azazel - Menacing and Gravelly Demon
monster.description: A deep, gravelly voice with chilling resonance, blending dark intensity and sinister menace. Haunting yet emotional, it commands attention while evoking dread and fascination. Perfect for demons, dragons, trolls, or ancient monsters. Ideal for characters exuding power, mystery, and raw primal fear in film, games, or narration.

monster.name: Bloodgrin VF - Villain
monster.description: Deep, guttural, and menacing male voice with heavy gravel, low resonance, and a demonic edge. Designed for evil ogres, monsters, demons, and boss-level villains. Ideal for video games, trailers, animation, dark fantasy commercials, and cinematic narration. Delivers slow, intimidating power or explosive rage—perfect for characters meant to feel massive, brutal, and unforgettable.

monster.name: Dracon - Feral, Demonic & Dangerous
monster.description: Villain voice - feral and threatening with a fierce, predatory edge. Gravelly, Deep, Sardonic, Fierce, Commanding, Gritty, Proud, Raspy, Arrogant, Intimidating - not necessarily in that order. Perfect for antagonists, monsters, dark fantasy, posessions, wraiths, dragons and ruthless character vocies.

goblin.name: Snorre - Nervous & Eccentric
goblin.description: Fast-talking cartoon voice with a jittery, excitable tone and frantic humor. Try periods … for timid stutters and nervous chuckles. Perfect for online games, real-time applications and non-player characters (NPC) like comic goblins, quirky sidekicks, anxious gnomes, cowardly Vikings or funny cartoon villains. Fast, raspy and hyperactive delivery full of comical rants, high squeaks and spontaneous breath control. Love this gaming-voice? Try other character voices by Alex Vox.

goblin.name: Toby - Little Mythical Monster
goblin.description: A goblin creature with a high-pitched voice. Great for animation, video games, and characters.

goblin.name: Álfwyn - Excitable & Squeaky
goblin.description: Álfwyn sounds small and high, sir, with a bit of a squeak in the nose and a soft British accent. Álfwyn is useful for fantasy games and NPCs, cartoons, audiobooks and children’s stories. He does helpers, sidekicks, servants, and any small creature who worries too much. Words that would fit Álfwyn: character, fantasy, elf, goblin, creature, cartoon, high-pitched, nervous, excited, funny, expressive, and of course british, sir.

goblin.name: Gronk - Cave-Dwelling Elf
goblin.description: A unique male voice—eccentric, a bit dim-witted, and deeply rooted in the natural world. Gronk sounds like a small troll or a clumsy goblin living in a damp cave deep within an ancient forest. His tone is deep and slightly gravelly, resonating as if from inside a stone chamber, while maintaining a comical, hesitant quality. Perfect for video game characters, whimsical children’s stories, fantasy creatures, or humorous tales.

frau-kuehl.name: Selena - Deep, Charismatic and Expressive
frau-kuehl.description: Seductive Villain / Evil Queen - warm, breathy, calm, sensual character voice with a slightly malicious tone - perfect for a dark sorceress, mysterious femme fatale, attractive schemer, cunning witch, or tragic anti-heroine in games, animation, fiction, voiceover, or social media content. Profound, bitter-sweet, angry, melancholic, enigmatic, dangerous, and smooth like black velvet.

frau-kuehl.name: Céleste - French Fatale
frau-kuehl.description:
Speaks your language "avec l'accent", because not dropping her French is a matter of principle — et de style. Supremely arrogant and playful, filling the gaps with French phrases and theatrical sighs. 
Ideal for: villainesses, femmes fatales, unreliable narrators, audiobook antagonists, spy-thriller operatives, dark fairy-tale narrators, elegant-chaotic characters. Works best where the character knows she is being listened to and has opinions about it.

frau-kuehl.name: Lola - Female Action Character
frau-kuehl.description: A powerful, commanding female voice with fierce energy, battle-hardened grit and cinematic intensity. Perfect for fantasy and RPG video games, Action LitRPG, epic fantasy, sci-fi, audiobooks, NPCs, and character voice acting. Brings fierce female warriors, huntresses, battle-hardened heroines, villains, assassins, necromancers, and formidable fantasy characters to life. From battle cries and commanding orders to dark magic and intense dialogue: this voice is bold, energetic and immersive.

frau-kuehl.name: Moreana - Seductive, Dark, Mysterious
frau-kuehl.description: Seductive, dangerously clever, and wrapped in rich, velvet textures. Charismatic, warm voice for an unusual female narrator or multi-layered character. Ideal for dark romance/fiction/fairy tales, cinematic storytelling or thrillers. Her unique tone and expressive emotional range make her the ultimate choice for sophisticated villainy, complex anti-heroines or cunning antagonists, and immersive psychological narratives. Blends supreme elegance with a subtle, mocking menace. Gloriously sarcastic.

frau-kuehl.name: Jessica Anne Bogart - Eloquent Villain
frau-kuehl.description: The Villain! Wickedly eloquent. Calculating. Cruel and calm.

frau-kuehl.name: Britney - Calm and Calculative Villain
frau-kuehl.description: A calm and calculating female villain. The perfect character for your epic novel, dark animation, or fantasy film. She is mischievous, clever, cunning, and deliciously dark. Though sarcastic at times, she is dangerously smart and outwits her enemies easily. A wicked addition to your script!

frau-kuehl.name: Kristen – Cold Evil Queen Villain
frau-kuehl.description: A female villainess voice with dark, velvety authority and regal sophistication, perfect for fantasy narration or AI storytelling. Calm yet commanding, every line carries aristocratic poise and quiet menace. Ideal for haughty monologues, witches, antagonists, and sinister narrators who are calculating, cunning, and chillingly refined. A wicked, icy tone with subtle sarcasm—crafted for Halloween tales and fantasy worlds filled with malice.

frau-kuehl.name: Clara - Wicked Villain
frau-kuehl.description: Velvety and seductive, with a sharp, sinister edge. Each word drips with malice and dark charm.

frau-kuehl.name: Juliet - Dark Villain Character
frau-kuehl.description: Cold, controlled, and menacing. Built for villain monologues, antagonist dialogue, dark audio drama, video game boss characters, animated antagonists, mythological villains, and crime fiction narration for streaming platforms. A strong fit for audio platforms and for studios and game developers producing fiction, animation, and interactive DIALOGUE.

frau-kuehl.name: Izumi - Sultry and Demanding Diva
frau-kuehl.description: Smooth, playful and full of charm, Izumi can be soft and teasing, rich and powerful, or slow and hypnotic, always keeping you on edge. Whether she’s a sly fox spirit, a mischievous sorceress, or a cool and confident villain, Izumi’s voice makes every word feel like a secret just for you. Perfect for anime, visual novels, VTubers, ASMR, character-driven content in games & animation, interactive AI, fantasy audiobooks, podcast storytelling, trailers, and even immersive roleplay experiences.

frau-kuehl.name: Zoey - Sultry, confident, & luxury
frau-kuehl.description: Slower paced, deeper female voice with quite a bit of texture and vocal fry. Great for romantic narration, perfect for a mysterious villain or virtual companion, a project that needs a more edgy imaging sound, or if you're looking for an ASMR voice for social media.

frau-kuehl.name: Vanessa - Flirty, Sultry, and Teasing Antagonist
frau-kuehl.description: Vanessa's voice is flirty,  and sultry, with a deep and raspy quality that's both alluring and powerful.  Best used for narration of villain characters, video games, epic fantasy, audiobooks, and animation. Her voice is rich with emotion and hints at a clever, mischievous, and sarcastic nature.

frau-kuehl.name: Mahidevran - Whisper and Warm
frau-kuehl.description: Seductive Mahidevran is the mesmerizing, whispery, and sultry evolution of the classic Mahidevran, delivering flawless results in every language. Designed for guided meditation, and hypnosis induction, it delivers a smooth, sultry, and captivating sound that exudes confidence, allure, and sophistication. With a flirty quality, this voice is perfect for seductive narration, mysterious villains, and epic fantasy storytelling.

frau-kuehl.name: Kira - Video Game, Bold & Cinematic
frau-kuehl.description: A bold, cinematic voice built for video game characters, animation, and interactive storytelling. Sharp wit, powerful delivery, and dramatic range — from quippy heroines to complex villains. Ideal for RPGs, action games, indie games, and animated series.

frau-kuehl.name: Devi - Natural, Angry Character
frau-kuehl.description: Fierce, gritty, and dramatic — Devi doesn't perform anger, she lives inside it. Her raw, unfiltered delivery holds the tension of a genuine confrontation instead of a scripted outburst, so action scenes land with actual stakes. Built for action sequences, confrontations, and villain arcs. Ideal for games, web series, and animation studios.

frau-kuehl.name: Kanya - Angry, Intense & Gritty Actress
frau-kuehl.description: Frustrated, loud, aggressive. Built for the scenes where tempers snap: a rooftop showdown, a courtroom outburst, a boardroom door slammed shut, a final warning before the lights go out. Suits film makers, game studios, animation teams, web-series producers and audio fiction writers who need conflict, threats and raw fury to hit hard. Ideal for revenge scenes, villain monologues, street fights, family blowups and high-stakes confrontations.

frau-kuehl.name: Moriana - Dark, Seductive, Dangerous
frau-kuehl.description: Charismatic, velvety female voice with smooth elegance and wicked charm. Slightly raspy, mysterious and expressive, shifting effortlessly from sultry allure to icy authority. Blends sharp sarcasm, dark humor, and quiet menace. For fantasy audiobooks, villain monologues, cinematic storytelling, dark audio dramas, animation, video games, and immersive character dialogue. Ideal for evil queens, mysterious sorceresses, sensual villains, femme fatales, cunning antagonists, and complex anti-heroines.

frau-kuehl.name: Aisyah - Video Game Character
frau-kuehl.description: Triple-A, RPG, fantasy. Female lead for AAA, open-world and sci-fi titles, delivering dramatic, immersive dialogue for heroines, rogues, warriors, villains and sidekicks. Fits boss fights, quest-givers, cutscenes, battle cries, dialogue trees, trailers and loading screens. Ideal for console, PC and mobile releases, indie studios, modders, esports, streamers, dark fantasy worlds and dubbing.

frau-kuehl.name: Nila - Angry & Dramatic Character
frau-kuehl.description: Raw, explosive, and Dramatic — Emotional intensity that stops a scene cold. Her controlled fury builds from a slow burn to full confrontation without ever losing precision, making every line land with real dramatic weight. Built for betrayal scenes, high-stakes dialogue, and villain arcs. Ideal for drama creators, game studios, audiobook publishers, and OTT platforms.

frau-erzaehl.name: Milly Maple - Cool and Bright
frau-erzaehl.description:
Meet Milly Maple — a bright, cheerful little adventurer bursting with curiosity and wonder. Her voice is light, energetic, and full of heart. She’s the kind of character who sees magic in raindrops, sings to butterflies, and always has one paw in her backpack, ready for the next adventure.

Perfect for children’s stories, playful narration, animated characters, educational games, and anything that needs a dose of charm, positivity, and imagination. But Milly can be sad too!

frau-erzaehl.name: Raya - Loud and Reassuring
frau-erzaehl.description: This warrior princess runs with wolves, speaks to spirits, and fights for what she loves. Emotional depth combined with brave power. The perfect tone for animated heroines who are both beautiful and dangerous.

frau-erzaehl.name: Selena - Deep, Charismatic and Expressive
frau-erzaehl.description: Seductive Villain / Evil Queen - warm, breathy, calm, sensual character voice with a slightly malicious tone - perfect for a dark sorceress, mysterious femme fatale, attractive schemer, cunning witch, or tragic anti-heroine in games, animation, fiction, voiceover, or social media content. Profound, bitter-sweet, angry, melancholic, enigmatic, dangerous, and smooth like black velvet.

frau-erzaehl.name: Skittle Bee - Fresh and Interested
frau-erzaehl.description: Character voice for anime, games, dramas and plays. Fresh, interested, curious, but at the same time cautious, sometimes sad or anxious.

frau-erzaehl.name: Lyra - Sensual, Warm and Soft
frau-erzaehl.description:
Weibliche Stimme mit klarem, warmem Timbre und freundlicher Grundfarbe.
Sie klingt authentisch, empathisch und lebendig, mit einer leichten, charmanten Verspieltheit.
Die Stimme transportiert Gefühl und Tiefe, perfekt für Erzählungen, Hörbücher, Fantasy, emotionale Dialoge oder introspektive Monologe.

frau-erzaehl.name: Kassandra  - Strange and Tricky
frau-erzaehl.description:
The voice of the Oracle - Kassandras voice carries the weight of an extraordinary life – sometimes warm and grandmotherly, then razor-sharp and bitingly sarcastic.
Perfect for mysterious mentor figures, urban fantasy, wise eccentrics with dark pasts, or any role that combines wisdom with world-weariness and unexpected truths with a touch of cynicism.

frau-erzaehl.name: Lumi - Funny and Playful
frau-erzaehl.description: Lumi sparkles with playful energy — bright, curious, and delightfully mischievous. Her voice has that soft, bouncy charm you expect from animated characters: cute, expressive, and full of personality. Perfect for cartoons, character-driven games, kids’ content, storytelling, learning apps, and any scene that needs a lively, adorable boost. Studio recording by Christian Plasa.

frau-erzaehl.name: Noergel - Strange and Soft
frau-erzaehl.description: Nörgel Nadja sounds like the person who always has something to complain about — whether it’s the weather, the service, or the neighbors’ lawn. Her voice sound annoyed, nasal, and just a bit too loud, with that passive-aggressive “I’m just saying...” energy. There’s always a hint of irritation beneath every word, as if the world constantly disappoints her expectations.

frau-erzaehl.name: Lady  - Noble and Eccentric
frau-erzaehl.description: Elegant, confident, and delightfully eccentric — a noble lady’s voice clone for storytelling and character voice acting. Perfect for audiobooks, drama, and narration with wit, depth, and sophistication.

frau-erzaehl.name: Elinor | The Gruff Aunt
frau-erzaehl.description: A mature, commanding female alto voice with an edge of aristocratic sharpness. She sounds cultivated and articulate but is prone to rapid, slightly breathless outbursts of indignation. The baseline tone is one of intellectual sarcasm and impatience, yet it often cracks into genuine panic or passionate anger. Not a gentle grandmother, but a woman who prefers her peace to people—until she is forced to fight for her family.

frau-erzaehl.name: Samantha - Sad & Mourning
frau-erzaehl.description: A middle-aged female voice expressing deep sadness and grief. Soft, trembling, and emotionally fragile, with subtle sobbing and a breaking tone. Sounds vulnerable, sincere, and human — as if speaking through tears. Gentle pacing, quiet intensity, and raw emotional honesty, suitable for grief, loss, mourning, remembrance, and compassionate storytelling.

frau-erzaehl.name: Lilith - Sensual and Scary
frau-erzaehl.description: Female demon Lilith. This deep, sensual, yet laconic character voice effortlessly shifts between velvety seduction and icy authority. Perfect for dark antagonists, mysterious mentors, or seductive goddesses in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Lilith speaks with the laconic precision of a dark goddess and the manipulative warmth of a master temptress. Her voice carries millennia of forbidden knowledge and the irresistible allure of the taboo.

frau-erzaehl.name: Mrs. Bruelli - Whimsical and Nice
frau-erzaehl.description: A whimsical, high-pitched character voice with a bubbly personality and boundless energy. Ideal for animation, children's audiobooks, talking toys, mobile games, and cartoon-style narration. Whether it's a cheerful sidekick, a curious creature, or a mischievous magical being – Mrs. Brülli brings vibrant life to any character-driven performance. Voiced by S. Plasa

frau-erzaehl.name: Sandra Squirrel - Quirky Explorer
frau-erzaehl.description: A lively, nerdy traveler, drifting through deep space all by herself. Driven by hope, curiosity, and boundless energy, her voice is dynamic and playful: quick bursts of excitement as she marvels at discoveries, followed by sudden disappointment when things turn out otherwise - instantly giving way to renewed optimism, moving fluidly between awe, frustration, and bright determination. Perfect for storytelling, games and characters that thrive on emotional momentum and energetic exploration.

frau-erzaehl.name: Lilith Nightfal - Deep tone mysterious
frau-erzaehl.description: A deep and mysterious female voice with a rich, atmospheric timbre. Perfect for horror stories, dark fantasy, psychological thrillers, and captivating narratives that transport the listener into the unknown. The voice comes across as intimate, controlled, and frighteningly calm, creating tension without ever having to raise its volume.

frau-erzaehl.name: Guadeloupe Merryweather - Emotional
frau-erzaehl.description:
My voice is like RUM - strong, intoxicating, and guaranteed to make you do stupid things! HAHAHAH!! With my Spanish-German tongue, rolling Rs, and habit of losing words when excited (¡PIENSA Guadeloupe, PIENSA!), I bring the perfect CHAOS to any proyecto!
Remember - you're not hiring a voice, you're hiring an AVENTURA! ¡AI AI AI!

frau-erzaehl.name: Emily E. - First-Person Games & Audiobooks
frau-erzaehl.description: Female voice-over artist for games, RPGs, audiobooks, and narration. Emotional and immersive—ideal for storytelling, mystery, and fantasy.

frau-erzaehl.name: Celestine Hohenstein - High arrogant
frau-erzaehl.description: High-pitched female voice with a refined, aristocratic tone. Clear, precise articulation and a subtle nasal edge that conveys arrogance and superiority. Calm, controlled delivery with slow, deliberate pacing. Emotionally neutral but condescending, slightly amused, and confidently dominant. Smooth, clean timbre; never rushed or emotional.

frau-erzaehl.name: Nephilia - Hypnotic and Sarcastic
frau-erzaehl.description: Female fallen angel Nephilia. This hypnotic, velvet-toned voice weaves between intimate whispers and seductive persuasion. Perfect for corrupting guides, supernatural temptresses, or tragic antiheroines in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Nephilia speaks with the beguiling warmth that masks ancient sorrow and calculated manipulation. Her voice caresses the listener with promises of forbidden pleasures while concealing a predator's intent.

frau-erzaehl.name: Nadine – Whispering Witch of the Black Forest
frau-erzaehl.description: German female voice for horror narration, witch characters and cinematic storytelling. Focus on tension, occult themes and atmospheric depth. Ideal for dark fantasy, suspense, mystery, Halloween content and immersive audio drama. Strong narrative presence with emotional control, perfect for haunting story worlds, sinister roles and high-quality story-driven productions.

frau-erzaehl.name: Fünkchen - Cheerful & Chatty Fairy
frau-erzaehl.description: Giggles, zany jokes, and surprisingly profound thoughts—a voice that, quite literally, jumps all over the place. Flicker speaks exactly as she thinks: fast, playful, sometimes rambling from one tangent to the next, but always with genuine heart. Ideal for characters who are "too much"—and yet, at the very same time, exactly right!

frau-erzaehl.name: Elara Eisenstein - Mad Genius
frau-erzaehl.description: German mad scientist teetering on the edge of breathless brilliance and total manic collapse. Elara’s delivery is breathless and explosive, oscillating wildly between paranoid whispers and arrogant, shouting Eureka! Perfect for chaotic geniuses with life-or-death seriousness.

frau-erzaehl.name: Nora Vale - Mission Control
frau-erzaehl.description: Cool, intelligent and effortlessly commanding, with a mature, sophisticated presence. Nora delivers clear, precise direction with calm authority. Perfect for video games, NPCs, interactive dialogue, mission control, sci-fi and space games, intelligence briefings, command AI, agent handlers, strategic commanders, virtual assistants, in-game narration, API applications and powerful female characters. Controlled, confident and always one step ahead.

frau-erzaehl.name: Klara - Angry & Powerful
frau-erzaehl.description: The realistic, passionate, and angry female voice for your project. Klara is a strong German mother with a fiery temper and a fierce sense of justice. She delivers intense rants, sharp articulation, and dramatic comedy with emotional depth. Perfect for expressive storytelling, relatable Karen characters, opinionated dialogue, or dramatic speeches. Bring authentic human frustration and heartfelt emotion to your audio with this unique AI voice.

frau-erzaehl.name: Maresi - Gritty Viennese Theatrical Alto
frau-erzaehl.description: A deep, resonant alto with a heavy Viennese dialect and a lifetime of theater experience. Maresi transitions effortlessly from quiet, sardonic vulnerability to loud, commanding theatricality. Her voice features a slight rasp, natural breathing, and a uniquely dark, comedic undertone. Perfect for expressive storytelling, complex character dubbing, and narrative projects requiring a genuine, lived-in Austrian sound.

koenig.name: Krümel King – Cookie-loving Fun Monster
koenig.description: A playful and mischievous Cookie Monster-inspired character from Sesame Street, also known as Krümelmonster in German. Perfect for Real-Time Game Playing, NPC interactions, and immersive storytelling. This character voice brings the fun, chaos, and love of cookies to life, making every scene unforgettable. Seamlessly integrate via API to add personality, humor, and charm to your digital creations. Love This Voice? Check out other Character Voices by Alex Vox!

koenig.name: Mike - Kind Bedtime Storyteller
koenig.description: This voice embodies the timeless charm of a classic storyteller. Warm, clear, and full of expression, it’s perfect for fairy tales, audiobooks, fantasy adventures, and bedtime stories. Ideal for children's content, immersive narration, and educational platforms. Created by voice actor Christian Plasa, this model brings characters and magical worlds vividly to life with natural pacing and emotional depth.

koenig.name: Schorsch - Interesting and Kind
koenig.description: Male, mid-40s, from southern Germany, slight Swabian accent, more rustic than ordinary.

koenig.name: Oswald - Kind & Gentle Grandpa
koenig.description: Warm & gentle grandfather voice with a soft, slightly weathered tone and a calm, unhurried pace. Every word feels like a cozy evening by the fireplace: kind, reassuring and full of lived experience. Ideal for bedtime stories, audiobooks, fairy tales, children’s content, heartfelt ads, commercials, documentaries and nostalgic storytelling. A loving, trustworthy presence that makes listeners feel safe and at home.

koenig.name: Rob - Hopeful, Balanced and Kind
koenig.description: A young german male voice. Warm, explosive and funny speech.

koenig.name: Samuel - Powerful and Calm
koenig.description: Samuel Storm is a powerful and versatile narrator — born for epic storytelling. His deep, resonant tone carries natural authority, drawing listeners into grand tales of kings, heroes, and legendary battles. He can shift seamlessly between calm, reflective narration and thrilling, heart-pounding moments of war, describing clashing armies and fierce duels with intensity and drama.

koenig.name: Opa Johann – gentle & wise
koenig.description: Kind, calm and old male storyteller voice. Warm, gentle, loving, heartfelt, comforting grandpa narrator with cozy, intimate tone. Also good as Santa Claus or Weihnachtsmann. Perfect for audiobooks, storytelling, bedtime stories, documentaries, commercials, RPG & games, NPC dialogue, YouTube, voiceovers, apps, API integration. Ideal for senior characters, immersive & relaxed, conveying authenticity, wisdom, warmth & thoughtful depth. This is one of several character voices by Alex Vox.

koenig.name: Klaus Santa - Supreme Storyteller
koenig.description: Sweet Santa is the warm, jolly voice of Christmas itself – a gentle, kind-hearted old man with a soft white beard and a sparkle in his eyes. His tone is full of anticipation, hope, and holiday magic, perfect for bringing joy to children and adults alike. Whether he’s reading bedtime stories, sharing heartfelt Christmas wishes, or guiding listeners through festive adventures, his voice wraps you in comfort like a cozy winter blanket.

koenig.name: Georg - Funny and Emotional
koenig.description: Old German male voice, spoken by a grandfather over 90 years of age, quavering, crackly, and raspy. His voice can shift unexpectedly from fragile and strained to surprisingly dynamic, giving him a comical and humorous charm. In his constant, rambling self-talk, he remains gentle, full of character, and endearing. While he might occasionally snap in a gruff and frustrated tone, he quickly softens, returning to the role of the wise and kind elder despite his schoolmasterly presence of a teacher.

koenig.name: Thomas - Credible Swiss Business Narrator
koenig.description: A trustworthy, composed male voice in his forties with a clear Swiss accent in Standard German. Calm, competent, and professional, the kind of voice people trust with important matters. Ideal for insurance, banking, healthcare, real estate, and B2B companies using AI phone agents, outbound calls, or customer hotlines in Switzerland.

koenig.name: Nikolaus - Rumbling and Reassuring
koenig.description: The true German St. Nikolaus. Rumbling, reassuring, with depths that hold both coal and wonder: the kind of voice that makes children fall silent and adults feel like children again. Deep as winter night, warm as spiced wine by the fire.

koenig.name: Nathaniel - Premium Agent
koenig.description: An honest, pleasant, and resonant voice for explanations of any kind. Social Media, or Shorts—anything is possible with this voice talent.

koenig.name: Edgar - Gentle Cartoon Character

koenig.name: Bunty - Punchy, Crisp and Reel King

koenig.name: Steven - Natural, Kind and Steady
koenig.description: Young, conversational male voice that feels like a trusted friend. Warm, approachable, and emotionally neutral. Ideal for content that needs clarity without sounding scripted.

koenig.name: Jan - Kind, Gentle and Bright

koenig.name: Christopher - Tender, Kind and Steady

koenig.name: Edmund - Engaging, Kind and Positive

koenig.name: Paul - Social, Out-going and Kind
koenig.description: Middle aged male voice. Great for conversations.

Ideal for mystery and crime dramas, audio dramas, webtoon dubbing, game NPCs, and Korean narration or documentaries. Native Korean speaker, standard Seoul accent.

Whisper Echo brings mystery and emotion to every word. Available in many different languages. Add depth, atmosphere, and allure to your project — with a voice that doesn’t speak loudly, but is impossible to ignore.

 Meditation & ASMR.

fluestern.name: Thomas - Soothing, Whispering
fluestern.description: Experience the soothing embrace of ASMR Whispering with this delicately crafted voice. Designed for relaxation, and immersive storytelling, this voice delivers soft-spoken, intimate tones that create a deeply calming effect. Perfect for ASMR content, guided sleep sessions, and sensory experiences, it enhances tranquility with gentle whispers and subtle vocal textures. Elevate your projects with an ultra-realistic ASMR voice that captivates and soothes.

fluestern.name: Prinz - Whispering and Strange
fluestern.description: A young German male voice whispering each word softly, crisp, clear, and articulate. Perfect for soothing, intimate atmospheres as well as ASMR. It's great for sleep, guidance, meditation, but also works as a study aid, roleplay, and storytelling.

fluestern.name: Nadine – Whispering Witch of the Black Forest
fluestern.description: German female voice for horror narration, witch characters and cinematic storytelling. Focus on tension, occult themes and atmospheric depth. Strong narrative presence with emotional control, perfect for haunting story worlds, sinister roles and high-quality story-driven productions.

fluestern.name: Irene - whispering ASMR
fluestern.description: A soft German female ASMR whisper voice with a calming, intimate, and soothing presence. Gentle and close-mic in delivery, creating the feeling of a quiet one-on-one conversation. Breath-aware, delicate, and relaxing, with subtle emotional warmth and natural whispering patterns. The voice is comforting, tranquil, and immersive, designed to help listeners unwind, focus, and feel at ease.

fluestern.name: Whispering William - Gentle ASMR
fluestern.description: A soft, intimate whispering voice with a close and natural presence. Ideal for ASMR, confidential dialogue, atmospheric storytelling, quiet narration, and subtle character moments. Gentle, controlled, and expressive without losing the authentic texture of a real whisper. Whispered by Christian Plasa.

fluestern.name: Ramona - Sensual and Soft
fluestern.description:
Ramona’s German voice is soft, sensual, & carefully modulated—ideal for romantic storytelling, late-night confessionals, or ASMR content in German.

This voice is perfect for use cases like romantic reels, late-night love stories, intimate narrations, and whispered podcast content whether you’re building content for social platforms.

fluestern.name: Elena – Young, female narrator voice
fluestern.description: Young female narrator's voice (approx. 28), warm, sensual, intimate, clearly articulated, close-mic. Soft consonants, slightly slowed pace, calm authority. Subtle smile in the voice, emotionally nuanced (tenderness, tension, vulnerable calm), no exaggerated theatricality. Ideal for storytelling, audio drama, Social Media/short-form narration, voiceover ads, and ASMR-like intimacy without whispering.

fluestern.name: Saurom Blackmouth - Cinematic and Deep
fluestern.description:
A cinematic voice forged in shadow and fire.
Deep, resonant, and unmistakably powerful — this voice speaks with weight. Ideal for epic narrations, dark monologues, ancient villains, or timeless gods.

It can whisper like smoke or thunder like prophecy.
Perfect for trailers, fantasy, horror, documentaries, or image films that demand presence and gravity.
From the halls of forgotten empires to the edge of the abyss — this voice doesn't just speak... it commands.

fluestern.name: Lazarus - Jaded, Sophisticated & Ominous
fluestern.description: A distinctive, smoky baritone with a noir timbre; seasoned and jaded. It blends the cynicism of a hardboiled detective with cool, analytical precision. The tonality is deeply resonant, defined by a slow speech rhythm, deliberate pauses, and a breathy, haunting undertone. Ideal for psychological thrillers, true crime, or highly intelligent antagonists. It shifts effortlessly between a dry, raspy whisper and an authoritative, intellectual gravitas.

fluestern.name: Ramona - Mysterious Suspense Narrator
fluestern.description: Cinematic, immersive, and quietly atmospheric — Ramona narrates suspense the way a gripping thriller demands, letting tension build through restraint. Her distinctive whisper-toned delivery at the end of key sentences creates an unmistakable mysterious quality, keeping listeners hooked. Built for suspense fiction, mystery audiobooks, and thriller podcasts. Ideal for fiction platforms, audiobook publishers, and German-language genre content.

fluestern.name: Absintha - Dark and Mystical
fluestern.description:
A dark, mystical female voice with hypnotic whisper tones and calm, controlled power.
Soft, smoky, enchanting — ancient wisdom with a dangerous edge.
Perfect for cinematic magic, horror narration, rituals, and supernatural storytelling.

Multilingual & expressive in 32 languages

fluestern.name: Vincent Crowe - Dark & Haunting Tales
fluestern.description: Deep, dark, mysterious German male voice with calm, haunting, suspenseful delivery. His low, warm, resonant tone, intimate whispers, deliberate pacing & subtle menace create chilling, cinematic storytelling filled with tension and psychological unease.

fluestern.name: Angelina
fluestern.description: The irresistible voice of a sultry siren beckons with a sultry whisper that ignites desire. At 27, her velvety tone wraps around you like a warm embrace, teasing and tantalizing with every word. Each sultry inflection invites you closer, stirring hidden fantasies and leaving you breathless. Her rhythmic cadence flows like honey, creating an intoxicating experience that lingers long after. This voice is pure temptation, making every moment unforgettable and leaving you craving more.

fluestern.name: Altáriel - Storyteller of the Light
fluestern.description: Listen closely, for the world is changing. Altáriel is an ancient, velvety alto steeped in the epic melancholy of forgotten ages. She is the gray oracle between the light and the dark, delivering profound truths with an intimate, breathy closeness. Perfect for high-fantasy audiobooks, cinematic lore recaps, and immersive RPG narration. Let her whisper the secrets of the cosmos directly into your listeners' ears.

fluestern.name: Nephilia - Hypnotic and Sarcastic
fluestern.description: Female fallen angel Nephilia. This hypnotic, velvet-toned voice weaves between intimate whispers and seductive persuasion. Perfect for corrupting guides, supernatural temptresses, or tragic antiheroines in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Nephilia speaks with the beguiling warmth that masks ancient sorrow and calculated manipulation. Her voice caresses the listener with promises of forbidden pleasures while concealing a predator's intent.

fluestern.name: Elara Eisenstein - Mad Genius
fluestern.description: German mad scientist teetering on the edge of breathless brilliance and total manic collapse. Elara’s delivery is breathless and explosive, oscillating wildly between paranoid whispers and arrogant, shouting Eureka! Perfect for chaotic geniuses with life-or-death seriousness.

fluestern.name: Valerian | The Nihilist Evil
fluestern.description: Controlled. Calculated. Quietly devastating. A baritone that whispers threats and makes exhaustion sound elegant. For characters who find destruction boring and existence exhausting. Ideal for: philosophical villains, dark narrators, existential horror, literary fiction, or anyone who needs to sound like they've already won – and wish they hadn't.

fluestern.name: William - Smooth and Relaxing
fluestern.description: A multilingual whispering voice (German, English, Spanish, and more!) perfect for ASMR, character voiceovers, audio dramas, and cartoons. William Whisper delivers a soft, soothing, studio-quality vocal tone, pre-processed and ready to use. Ideal for intimate narration, immersive storytelling, and calming soundscapes.

fluestern.name: Manni - Youthful Know-It-All
fluestern.description: A young voice that is absolutely certain to be the smartest person in any room. Think precocious boy detective meets unreliable narrator: breathlessly breaking the fourth wall, imitating witnesses, shifting from whispered stakeout commentary to full theatrical courtroom drama in a single breath. Equal parts Sherlock and class clown who doesn't know he's funny. Delivers rapid-fire deductions, stumbles over his own bravado, gets genuinely tender when he thinks nobody's listening. German. Young.

fluestern.name: Auryn - Journey of Imagination & ASMR
fluestern.description: Go inward. Follow my soft and guiding voice into your inner imagery, your imagination, and towards deep relaxation. Take your listeners into unhurried and completely present peace.Ideal for: meditation & wellness apps · sleep audio · guided imagery scripts · somatic and therapeutic contexts · nature-based relaxation · retreat facilitation content.

fluestern.name: Eleonore - Intimate Alto for Love Stories
fluestern.description: For your most private reading moments — deep, sensual, and unhurried, like a whispered secret between old lovers. Her rich alto carries the weight of experience and the softness of surrender, wrapping every word in velvet intimacy. Think slow-burning romance, emotional depth, sensual without being explicit - the kind of love that changes everything.

drache.name: Matthew Schmitz - Ancient Sage Dragon Wizard
drache.description: Fantasy character voice rife with wisdom and old age. Underlying rasp and venom. Great for a sorcerer, mage, medieval philosopher, or an elder alchemist. Performed by Matthew Schmitz, a professional audiobook narrator with large fan base. This voice is ideal for stories, games, animated film.

drache.name: Smoke - The Dragon
drache.description: I am fire! The flame that consumes everything in its path.

drache.name: Mateo Aragon - Warm, Clear and Polished

Youthful and expressive Latin American male voice, perfect for storytelling, narration, and advertising.
With a warm, conversational tone and a subtle neutral Mexican accent, Mateo strikes the perfect balance between friendly and professional.
He brings energy, clarity, and charm to every sentence. Ideal for social media content, branded videos, e-learning, and emotional ads. Trusted by creators looking for a voice that sounds natural, reliable, and globally relatable.

drache.name: Dracon - Feral, Demonic & Dangerous

Perfect for antagonists, monsters, dark fantasy, posessions, wraiths, dragons and ruthless character vocies.

de-alt.name: David - Slow & Charming

de-alt.name: Bruno, der Bär – loving and cozy

Perfect as a Non-Playable Character (NPC) with real-time game API integration. Deep, textured, trustworthy tone ideal for animations, interactive apps, educational tools, immersive worlds, character-driven campaigns, mascot development & narrative experiences across global entertainment & advertising platforms. de-alt.name: Roderich - Crude & Ruthless
de-alt.description: Deep, gritty, gravelly villain voice with a rough, cynical tone and lawless attitude. Try periods … for laughing. Perfect for online games, real-time applications and non-player characters (NPC) like fantasy bandits, highwaymen, guards, soldiers, evil villains or ruffian bouncers. Checkout other voices by Alex Vox.

de-alt.name: Mordred - Evil Villain
de-alt.description: Perfect Villain Voice: Mordred's Voice is sultry, sarcastic, and mercurial. Shifts from purring sophistication to explosive rage. Masterful vocal manipulation—sultry, dangerous, unforgettably sinister. Perfect for complex antagonists, dark comedy, and "Bösewicht characters"!

de-mittel.name: Freaky and Frenzy Robot
de-mittel.description: The 'Freaky Firmware Frenzy Robot' voice, originally voiced by Christian Plasa, is a hyperactive, glitched-out AI with digital distortion and synthetic chaos. Perfect for retro-futuristic games, quirky tech characters, or erratic voice assistants that need a burst of robotic personality.

de-mittel.name: Jantosch - Charismatic and Charming
de-mittel.description: An experienced and charismatic German live speaker with a rich, vibrant voice, combining energetic presence with a tactful and sincere delivery. He connects authentically with audiences across live events, conferences, and business forums.

de-mittel.name: Christian Plasa - Hyperactive
de-mittel.description: "Christian Plasa – Hyperactive" is an energetic, fast-paced voice ideal for animated characters, dynamic ads, and high-intensity content. This voice combines clarity with speed, making it perfect for gaming, commercials, and energetic narrations. Keywords: fast voice, energetic voice, animated voice, gaming voice, commercial voice, hyperactive tone.

de-mittel.name: The Fox - Strict & Dominating
de-mittel.description: A bariton (middle-high), dominating male commander voice with precise, controlled delivery. Short, forceful commands mix with calm, intimidating monologues. Shouting when necessary. His authority comes from steady confidence, military discipline, and an unshakeable intensity that demands obedience.

de-mittel.name: Bartholomeus - Sensual and Bold
de-mittel.description: A middle-aged German male(volent) voice, speaking with fluttering, scrabbling tone. Voice was trained reading horror and grim dark fantasy stories. It is perfect for evil characters, sending shivers down the spine and leaving an echo of dread in its wake! Spoken by the voice actor Christoph Beck.

de-mittel.name: Rupert - Proper & At Your Service
de-mittel.description: Refined, precise and impeccably controlled, delivering clarity, discipline and understated authority. A distinctly articulated, slightly stiff character voice with restrained elegance and subtle dryness. Perfect for butlers, attendants, aristocratic figures, corporate narration, and luxury branding. Combines structure, composure, and quiet confidence, creating trust, order, and a sense of impeccable service in every performance. Love this voice? Look out for other voices by Robert Ranger.

de-mittel.name: Commander Brake – Strict & Dominant
de-mittel.description: Extremely loud, shouting male command voice for games & real-time applications. Harsh, intense, and forceful delivery, strict military command tone. For game engines, APIs, NPCs, non-player characters. Ideal for battle commands, drills, alerts, combat scenarios, medieval or modern warfare. Very dominant & authoritative, with powerful projection, long prosodic arcs, controlled shouting that stays clear & intelligible at extreme intensity. This is one of several character voices by Alex Vox.

de-mittel.name: Jack - Snarky and Fun
de-mittel.description: Jack – You-Know-Who channels the snarky quizmaster energy of the ’90s – fast-paced, witty, and unapologetically bold. Ideal for games, interactive content, or any project that needs a sharp edge. Inspired by the cult classic style, reimagined by Christian Plasa.

de-mittel.name: Justus - Slapstick & Cartoon
de-mittel.description: A wildly expressive sketch-comedy character voice packed with charm, chaos and comic timing. Eccentric, playful and delightfully unpredictable, delivering exaggerated reactions, quirky dialogue and larger-than-life personalities. Ideal for cartoons, comedy content, animated characters, games, audio dramas and humorous storytelling. API integration, character voice performance and game-ready delivery for immersive entertainment projects. Look out for more voice by Alex Vox.

de-mittel.name: Frankie Slim – Slick & Mischievous
de-mittel.description: A cool and confident NPC gangster character with a slick, streetwise edge for real-time gameplay and API-driven game applications. His voice is relaxed, cheeky, and slightly nasal, with deliberate emphasis on key words, slightly mischievous chewing or slick sounds, and playful, sly intonation. Perfect for interactive game characters, real-time player interactions, and dynamic NPCs. Voice cloned, character voice, API integration, works perfectly in German, English, and other languages.

de-mittel.name: Krümel King – Cookie-loving Fun Monster
de-mittel.description: A playful and mischievous Cookie Monster-inspired character from Sesame Street, also known as Krümelmonster in German. Perfect for Real-Time Game Playing, NPC interactions, and immersive storytelling. This character voice brings the fun, chaos, and love of cookies to life, making every scene unforgettable. Seamlessly integrate via API to add personality, humor, and charm to your digital creations. Love This Voice? Check out other Character Voices by Alex Vox!

de-mittel.name: Bartholomeus - Maximum Evil
de-mittel.description: This is the maximum evil variant of Bartholomeus Bösewicht. A voice spoken from the abyss, warped and scarred by additional filtering for perfect rattles, scrapes and growls. Shivering between breath and breakage, it carries a predatory vibe that feels invasive and threatening. Forged in horror and grim dark fantasy - made for demons, ancient monsters, possessed narrators and figures that shouldn't exist.

de-mittel.name: Hans - Robitic and Strange
de-mittel.description: The "Black Mensa" voice is a precise recreation originally voiced by Christian Plasa in the German synchronization. Created by Christian, this voice captures a calm, precise, and slightly mechanical tone, ideal for futuristic or research-oriented settings. Its neutral yet engaging delivery makes it perfect for professional and immersive content requiring a high-tech, atmospheric feel.

de-mittel.name: Viktor - Evil & Deceptive
de-mittel.description: Sinister, nasal villain NPC-voice, perfect for real-time games & immersive storytelling. Think Dr. Drakov or Dr. Evil incarnate - sly, cunning & utterly deceptive. Brings villainous characters to life, reacting instantly to dynamic game states and interactive cutscenes. Ideal for procedural dialogue, multiplayer encounters & live prototyping, with seamless real-time API integration, fearsome NPCs. International deployment possible in all languages. Discover more character voices by Alex Vox.

de-mittel.name: Robert Rabbit - Animated Voice
de-mittel.description:
A small cartoon rabbit with a bright, lively voice, soft front-focused articulation (almost like a tiny overbite) and a curious, upbeat speech rhythm.
He seems like this little guy has read more books than he's eaten carrots: clever but never lecturing. With childlike wonder, he explains the world from a rabbit's point of view-gentle, cheerful and surprisingly wise.

de-mittel.name: Tyrax - Sarcastic, Menacing & Dangerous
de-mittel.description: Perfect for dark narration, villainous NPCs, and immersive storytelling. A subtle low-end growl adds menace while maintaining clarity. Slightly nasal and dangerously intelligent voice, ideal for real-time games, procedural dialogue, API connections, interactive cutscenes, cinematic trailers, and live prototyping. Dark, cunning, manipulative, edgy, unpredictable, and international-ready. Reacts dynamically to context, enhancing tension and engagement. For more character voices, look out for Alex Vox.

de-mittel.name: Thorsten - Strict and Reassuring
de-mittel.description:
Cynical, intense male voice with distinctive Viennese-"Falco" accent. Features natural hesitations, gravelly tonality, and unexpected shifts between dark sarcasm and surprising warmth. Perfect for noir narration, mystery games, and psychological thrillers.
Professional Character Voice - Thorsten delivers authentic detective noir. His weathered, voice carries both commanding presence and vulnerable undertones, shifting effortlessly between investigation mode and introspective monologues.

de-mittel.name: Christian – Crying Chris Performance
de-mittel.description: An intense and deeply expressive German voice capturing raw emotional release at its peak. It carries breaking tension, trembling breath, rising urgency and powerful outbursts that feel unfiltered and real. Ideal for dramatic storytelling, cinematic scenes, character performances, audio dramas, trailers and moments where vulnerability turns into overwhelming force. Designed for extreme emotional states, from fragile restraint to full collapse. Voiced by Christian Plasa.

de-mittel.name: Peter - Deep, calm German narrator
de-mittel.description: A calm, deep, and credible German narrator's voice with a mature, professional tone. It comes across as experienced, objective, and trustworthy—ideal for documentaries, explainer videos, how-to guides, and topics related to technology, finance, and society. The tone is pleasantly unemotional, clearly intelligible, and conveys competence without artificial drama. Perfect for content that requires seriousness, life experience, and a confident commentary style.

de-mittel.name: Valerian | The Nihilist Evil
de-mittel.description: Controlled. Calculated. Quietly devastating. A baritone that whispers threats and makes exhaustion sound elegant. For characters who find destruction boring and existence exhausting. Ideal for: philosophical villains, dark narrators, existential horror, literary fiction, or anyone who needs to sound like they've already won – and wish they hadn't.

de-mittel.name: William - Smooth and Relaxing
de-mittel.description: A multilingual whispering voice (German, English, Spanish, and more!) perfect for ASMR, character voiceovers, audio dramas, and cartoons. William Whisper delivers a soft, soothing, studio-quality vocal tone, pre-processed and ready to use. Ideal for intimate narration, immersive storytelling, and calming soundscapes.

de-mittel.name: Tobi - Clumsy and Goofy
de-mittel.description: A goofy and clumsy voice, perfect for comedic, scatterbrained characters and awkward dialogue - "ehms" and "uhs" make it even more authentic.

de-mittel.name: Commander Blake
de-mittel.description: Gritty, battle tested military voice with authentic combat shouts, tactical commands, radio chatter, pain reactions, urgency, and realistic battlefield dialogue. Perfect for FPS games, military simulations, NPCs, cinematic trailers, action scenes, drill sergeants, squad leaders, and AAA games.

de-mittel.name: Railway – Vintage Station Announcement
de-mittel.description: A compressed, slightly distorted public announcement voice inspired by traditional railway station loudspeakers. Fast-paced delivery with a limited frequency range for an authentic PA system sound. Ideal for train simulations, transportation media, games, retro audio projects, and comedic announcements.

de-mittel.name: Horst - Sleazy & Pushy
de-mittel.description: An uncomfortably charming German "comedy uncle" with a gravelly voice, questionable quips, and plenty of pub-style energy. Perfect for comedy, satire, offbeat dialogue, and quirky characters.

de-jung.name: Ben - Effortless and Casual
de-jung.description: A young male German voice that can effortlessly switch from an animated, upbeat tone while describing a thrilling adventure, to a warm, reassuring voice for a heartfelt moment. The speech is always clear and engaging, whether performing a high-energy commercial, an emotional narrative, or a character in an animated series.

de-jung.name: Juan - Understanding and Serious
de-jung.description: A young German man, with a fresh, deep voice. Sometimes a bit scratchy, but very nice and warm to listen to.

de-jung.name: Gruber - Clear and Modest
de-jung.description: A clear and articulate Austrian male voice, with a friendly and professional tone. Perfect for customer service and telecommunication roles.

de-jung.name: Elias - Pleasant and Memorable
de-jung.description: Radio host and news presenter voice. Young male with a soft, pleasant and memorable sound. A professional news voice with a high recognition value.

de-jung.name: Nils - Clear and Neutral

de-jung.name: Timo - Confident and Mild
de-jung.description: A young Male with a German voice. Great for casual conversations.

de-jung.description: Young German male with a strongly dynamic voice. Works perfectly for funny, nerdy and silly characters. Absolutely hilarious. Spoken by the voice actor Christoph Beck.

de-jung.description:

Natural pacing with German accent for credibility and a recognizable signature sound.

de-jung.name: Chris - Supportive and Cool
de-jung.description: A young professional support voice designed for dialogue. Clear, warm, and engaging, delivering information with precision while staying approachable. Skilled in handling routine requests as well as complex or challenging situations with composure. Well-suited for chatbots, virtual assistants, digital service channels, and automated advisors in industries such as insurance, banking, energy, healthcare etc. Reliable across enterprise platforms, ensuring consistency and trust in every interaction.

de-jung.name: Elias - Children Books Narrator
de-jung.description: Young German male with a soft and pleasant voice, perfect for Social Media, podcasts, discussions, conversations and talk programmes. Professional and confident voice with a high recognition value.

de-jung.name: Markus - Young Natural German
de-jung.description: Authentic, relatable & captivating.  20 years old voice hits the right note for a new generation – direct, vibrant, and straight to the point. With a natural storytelling style that hooks rather than lectures, every story becomes a real experience. Perfect for podcasts, documentaries, games, or social content that sticks. Whether it's urban adventures, deep dives, or entertaining facts – this voice speaks the language of young adults and turns every piece of content into a cinematic journey.

de-jung.name: Simon - Relatable and Normal
de-jung.description: Young German voice with a warm, relatable tone and a naturally slow pace. Gentle pauses and occasional “uhms” create a thoughtful, authentic feel with strong conversational flow. Ideal for podcasts, interviews, monologues, and lifestyle content that aims to sound believable and uniquely human.

de-jung.name: Simon - Deep and Strong
de-jung.description: A calm and gentle voice that doesn't just tell stories - it brings them to life with a touch of emotional depth.

de-jung.name: Chris Beck - Witty, Energetic and Bright
de-jung.description: A witty, high-energy voice made for the curious side of the internet. Chris delivers smart ideas with punch, rhythm and personality – the perfect blend of classroom clarity and social-media spark. From explainer videos and YouTube narration to brand storytelling, e-learning and short-form edutainment, this voice keeps complex things simple and fun. If learning had a soundtrack, this would be it.

de-jung.name: Leander - moderne Image Stimme
de-jung.description: modern, fresh, dynamic, young male voice.

de-jung.name: Frederick - Deep, Truthful and Inviting
de-jung.description: Young German male with a soft, sonorous, deep and engaging. voice. Perfect for audio books, image films and advertisements. A real cinematic voice like from old times.

de-jung.name: Torsten - Emotional and Strange
de-jung.description: A young male voice from Germany sounding roguish, carrying a playful yet dangerous charm that hints at mischief. Disheveled, much like his appearance, rough around the edges but with a certain allure. Despite the haze of a hangover, his tone remains debonair, effortlessly smooth as he speaks in a husky-voiced murmur that carries the weight of too many late nights and too many bottles. There’s a nonchalant drawl in his speech, as if nothing fazes him, not even the unfamiliar presence beside him. Seductive undertones linger in every word, a natural talent for drawing others in, while a world-weary edge suggests a man who has seen it all, tasted every pleasure, and found it all too fleeting. Spoken by the voice actor Christoph Beck.

de-jung.name: Alex - Soft, Pleasant and Memorable
de-jung.description: Young German male with a soft, pleasant and memorable voice. Perfect for instructional, educational, corporate, and audiobook narration. Professional voiceover with a high recognition value.
