de-jung.description: Crazy, cute, clumsy bunny with playful lisp and irresistible charm. Perfect Osterhase / Easter Bunny voice for Ostern campaigns, kids content, animation, cartoons, games, NPC Characters, real-time interaction and API Integration. This lisping rabbit character delivers high-energy comedy, sweet innocence, chaotic humor, and heartwarming moments for holiday specials, apps and immersive storytelling. Want more character voices? Look out for Alex Vox. Ideal for seasonal ads and playful mascots.

de-jung.name: Chris Beck - Young Ads
de-jung.description: Young, modern male voice, with a dynamic and confident delivery. Clear articulation, precise pacing, and strong presence create a persuasive, forward-moving tone. The sound is contemporary, focused, and professional, while remaining approachable. Brand names are emphasized. Ideal for direct response advertising, tech explainers, product launches, and performance-driven campaigns.

de-frau.name: Milly Maple - Cool and Bright
de-frau.description:
Meet Milly Maple — a bright, cheerful little adventurer bursting with curiosity and wonder. Her voice is light, energetic, and full of heart. She’s the kind of character who sees magic in raindrops, sings to butterflies, and always has one paw in her backpack, ready for the next adventure.

Perfect for children’s stories, playful narration, animated characters, educational games, and anything that needs a dose of charm, positivity, and imagination. But Milly can be sad too!

de-frau.name: Raya - Loud and Reassuring
de-frau.description: This warrior princess runs with wolves, speaks to spirits, and fights for what she loves. Emotional depth combined with brave power. The perfect tone for animated heroines who are both beautiful and dangerous.

de-frau.name: Selena - Deep, Charismatic and Expressive
de-frau.description: Seductive Villain / Evil Queen - warm, breathy, calm, sensual character voice with a slightly malicious tone - perfect for a dark sorceress, mysterious femme fatale, attractive schemer, cunning witch, or tragic anti-heroine in games, animation, fiction, voiceover, or social media content. Profound, bitter-sweet, angry, melancholic, enigmatic, dangerous, and smooth like black velvet.

de-frau.name: Skittle Bee - Fresh and Interested
de-frau.description: Character voice for anime, games, dramas and plays. Fresh, interested, curious, but at the same time cautious, sometimes sad or anxious.

de-frau.name: Lyra - Sensual, Warm and Soft
de-frau.description:
Weibliche Stimme mit klarem, warmem Timbre und freundlicher Grundfarbe.
Sie klingt authentisch, empathisch und lebendig, mit einer leichten, charmanten Verspieltheit.
Die Stimme transportiert Gefühl und Tiefe, perfekt für Erzählungen, Hörbücher, Fantasy, emotionale Dialoge oder introspektive Monologe.

de-frau.name: Kassandra  - Strange and Tricky
de-frau.description:
The voice of the Oracle - Kassandras voice carries the weight of an extraordinary life – sometimes warm and grandmotherly, then razor-sharp and bitingly sarcastic.
Perfect for mysterious mentor figures, urban fantasy, wise eccentrics with dark pasts, or any role that combines wisdom with world-weariness and unexpected truths with a touch of cynicism.

de-frau.name: Lumi - Funny and Playful
de-frau.description: Lumi sparkles with playful energy — bright, curious, and delightfully mischievous. Her voice has that soft, bouncy charm you expect from animated characters: cute, expressive, and full of personality. Perfect for cartoons, character-driven games, kids’ content, storytelling, learning apps, and any scene that needs a lively, adorable boost. Studio recording by Christian Plasa.

de-frau.name: Noergel - Strange and Soft
de-frau.description: Nörgel Nadja sounds like the person who always has something to complain about — whether it’s the weather, the service, or the neighbors’ lawn. Her voice sound annoyed, nasal, and just a bit too loud, with that passive-aggressive “I’m just saying...” energy. There’s always a hint of irritation beneath every word, as if the world constantly disappoints her expectations.

de-frau.name: Lady  - Noble and Eccentric
de-frau.description: Elegant, confident, and delightfully eccentric — a noble lady’s voice clone for storytelling and character voice acting. Perfect for audiobooks, drama, and narration with wit, depth, and sophistication.

de-frau.name: Elinor | The Gruff Aunt
de-frau.description: A mature, commanding female alto voice with an edge of aristocratic sharpness. She sounds cultivated and articulate but is prone to rapid, slightly breathless outbursts of indignation. The baseline tone is one of intellectual sarcasm and impatience, yet it often cracks into genuine panic or passionate anger. Not a gentle grandmother, but a woman who prefers her peace to people—until she is forced to fight for her family.

de-frau.name: Samantha - Sad & Mourning
de-frau.description: A middle-aged female voice expressing deep sadness and grief. Soft, trembling, and emotionally fragile, with subtle sobbing and a breaking tone. Sounds vulnerable, sincere, and human — as if speaking through tears. Gentle pacing, quiet intensity, and raw emotional honesty, suitable for grief, loss, mourning, remembrance, and compassionate storytelling.

de-frau.name: Lilith - Sensual and Scary
de-frau.description: Female demon Lilith. This deep, sensual, yet laconic character voice effortlessly shifts between velvety seduction and icy authority. Perfect for dark antagonists, mysterious mentors, or seductive goddesses in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Lilith speaks with the laconic precision of a dark goddess and the manipulative warmth of a master temptress. Her voice carries millennia of forbidden knowledge and the irresistible allure of the taboo.

de-frau.name: Mrs. Bruelli - Whimsical and Nice
de-frau.description: A whimsical, high-pitched character voice with a bubbly personality and boundless energy. Ideal for animation, children's audiobooks, talking toys, mobile games, and cartoon-style narration. Whether it's a cheerful sidekick, a curious creature, or a mischievous magical being – Mrs. Brülli brings vibrant life to any character-driven performance. Voiced by S. Plasa

de-frau.name: Sandra Squirrel - Quirky Explorer
de-frau.description: A lively, nerdy traveler, drifting through deep space all by herself. Driven by hope, curiosity, and boundless energy, her voice is dynamic and playful: quick bursts of excitement as she marvels at discoveries, followed by sudden disappointment when things turn out otherwise - instantly giving way to renewed optimism, moving fluidly between awe, frustration, and bright determination. Perfect for storytelling, games and characters that thrive on emotional momentum and energetic exploration.

de-frau.name: Lilith Nightfal - Deep tone mysterious
de-frau.description: A deep and mysterious female voice with a rich, atmospheric timbre. Perfect for horror stories, dark fantasy, psychological thrillers, and captivating narratives that transport the listener into the unknown. The voice comes across as intimate, controlled, and frighteningly calm, creating tension without ever having to raise its volume.

de-frau.name: Guadeloupe Merryweather - Emotional
de-frau.description:
My voice is like RUM - strong, intoxicating, and guaranteed to make you do stupid things! HAHAHAH!! With my Spanish-German tongue, rolling Rs, and habit of losing words when excited (¡PIENSA Guadeloupe, PIENSA!), I bring the perfect CHAOS to any proyecto!
Remember - you're not hiring a voice, you're hiring an AVENTURA! ¡AI AI AI!

de-frau.name: Emily E. - First-Person Games & Audiobooks
de-frau.description: Female voice-over artist for games, RPGs, audiobooks, and narration. Emotional and immersive—ideal for storytelling, mystery, and fantasy.

de-frau.name: Celestine Hohenstein - High arrogant
de-frau.description: High-pitched female voice with a refined, aristocratic tone. Clear, precise articulation and a subtle nasal edge that conveys arrogance and superiority. Calm, controlled delivery with slow, deliberate pacing. Emotionally neutral but condescending, slightly amused, and confidently dominant. Smooth, clean timbre; never rushed or emotional.

de-frau.name: Nephilia - Hypnotic and Sarcastic
de-frau.description: Female fallen angel Nephilia. This hypnotic, velvet-toned voice weaves between intimate whispers and seductive persuasion. Perfect for corrupting guides, supernatural temptresses, or tragic antiheroines in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Nephilia speaks with the beguiling warmth that masks ancient sorrow and calculated manipulation. Her voice caresses the listener with promises of forbidden pleasures while concealing a predator's intent.

de-frau.name: Nadine – Whispering Witch of the Black Forest
de-frau.description: German female voice for horror narration, witch characters and cinematic storytelling. Focus on tension, occult themes and atmospheric depth. Ideal for dark fantasy, suspense, mystery, Halloween content and immersive audio drama. Strong narrative presence with emotional control, perfect for haunting story worlds, sinister roles and high-quality story-driven productions.

de-frau.name: Fünkchen - Cheerful & Chatty Fairy
de-frau.description: Giggles, zany jokes, and surprisingly profound thoughts—a voice that, quite literally, jumps all over the place. Flicker speaks exactly as she thinks: fast, playful, sometimes rambling from one tangent to the next, but always with genuine heart. Ideal for characters who are "too much"—and yet, at the very same time, exactly right!

de-frau.name: Elara Eisenstein - Mad Genius
de-frau.description: German mad scientist teetering on the edge of breathless brilliance and total manic collapse. Elara’s delivery is breathless and explosive, oscillating wildly between paranoid whispers and arrogant, shouting Eureka! Perfect for chaotic geniuses with life-or-death seriousness.

de-frau.name: Nora Vale - Mission Control
de-frau.description: Cool, intelligent and effortlessly commanding, with a mature, sophisticated presence. Nora delivers clear, precise direction with calm authority. Perfect for video games, NPCs, interactive dialogue, mission control, sci-fi and space games, intelligence briefings, command AI, agent handlers, strategic commanders, virtual assistants, in-game narration, API applications and powerful female characters. Controlled, confident and always one step ahead.

de-frau.name: Klara - Angry & Powerful
de-frau.description: The realistic, passionate, and angry female voice for your project. Klara is a strong German mother with a fiery temper and a fierce sense of justice. She delivers intense rants, sharp articulation, and dramatic comedy with emotional depth. Perfect for expressive storytelling, relatable Karen characters, opinionated dialogue, or dramatic speeches. Bring authentic human frustration and heartfelt emotion to your audio with this unique AI voice.

de-frau.name: Maresi - Gritty Viennese Theatrical Alto
de-frau.description: A deep, resonant alto with a heavy Viennese dialect and a lifetime of theater experience. Maresi transitions effortlessly from quiet, sardonic vulnerability to loud, commanding theatricality. Her voice features a slight rasp, natural breathing, and a uniquely dark, comedic undertone. Perfect for expressive storytelling, complex character dubbing, and narrative projects requiring a genuine, lived-in Austrian sound.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Absintha - Dark and Mystical
de-frau-dunkel.description:
A dark, mystical female voice with hypnotic whisper tones and calm, controlled power.
Soft, smoky, enchanting — ancient wisdom with a dangerous edge.
Perfect for cinematic magic, horror narration, rituals, and supernatural storytelling.

Multilingual & expressive in 32 languages

de-frau-dunkel.name: Ramona - Dark Thriller Storyteller
de-frau-dunkel.description: Spine-Chilling, Intense, Dramatic — Ramona drops her voice just low enough that listeners lean toward the speaker without realizing it, letting a single word sit in silence longer than feels comfortable. Her delivery holds that hush steady across a full chapter, never breaking tension with a line that arrives too fast. Built for horror fiction podcasts, true-crime audio dramas, and late-night listening apps.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Yasmin - Dark & strong
de-frau-dunkel.description: Professional podcast host voice with a clear, engaging delivery, ideal for voice-over, moderation, and conversational narration.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Moreana - Seductive, Dark, Mysterious
de-frau-dunkel.description: Seductive, dangerously clever, and wrapped in rich, velvet textures. Charismatic, warm voice for an unusual female narrator or multi-layered character. Ideal for dark romance/fiction/fairy tales, cinematic storytelling or thrillers. Her unique tone and expressive emotional range make her the ultimate choice for sophisticated villainy, complex anti-heroines or cunning antagonists, and immersive psychological narratives. Blends supreme elegance with a subtle, mocking menace. Gloriously sarcastic.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Marlena Lark – Warm German Narrator
de-frau-dunkel.description: Marlena Lark is a warm, clear and professional German female voice with a natural, conversational and trustworthy tone. Ideal for German voiceovers, e-learning, online courses, training videos, explainers, corporate narration, brand films, product tutorials, audioguides, documentaries, podcasts, soft video sales letters and conversational AI agents. Refined, articulate and engaging, she sounds credible and human.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Selena - Deep, Charismatic and Expressive
de-frau-dunkel.description: Seductive Villain / Evil Queen - warm, breathy, calm, sensual character voice with a slightly malicious tone - perfect for a dark sorceress, mysterious femme fatale, attractive schemer, cunning witch, or tragic anti-heroine in games, animation, fiction, voiceover, or social media content. Profound, bitter-sweet, angry, melancholic, enigmatic, dangerous, and smooth like black velvet.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lola - Immersive Storytelling
de-frau-dunkel.description: A warm, expressive German female voice for audiobook narration. She combines emotional depth, calm authority, and subtle sensuality, bringing love stories, dark romance, biographies, intimate character-driven and literary narratives to life. Thoughtful and articulate, she shapes stories with nuance, mystery, and dramatic intensity. Her empathetic presence and natural pacing create vivid, emotionally resonant moments and imagery for long-form listening.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Kassandra  - Strange and Tricky
de-frau-dunkel.description:
The voice of the Oracle - Kassandras voice carries the weight of an extraordinary life – sometimes warm and grandmotherly, then razor-sharp and bitingly sarcastic.
Perfect for mysterious mentor figures, urban fantasy, wise eccentrics with dark pasts, or any role that combines wisdom with world-weariness and unexpected truths with a touch of cynicism.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lilith - Sensual and Scary
de-frau-dunkel.description: Female demon Lilith. This deep, sensual, yet laconic character voice effortlessly shifts between velvety seduction and icy authority. Perfect for dark antagonists, mysterious mentors, or seductive goddesses in games, audiobooks, and narrative projects. Lilith speaks with the laconic precision of a dark goddess and the manipulative warmth of a master temptress. Her voice carries millennia of forbidden knowledge and the irresistible allure of the taboo.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lilith Nightfal - Deep tone mysterious
de-frau-dunkel.description: A deep and mysterious female voice with a rich, atmospheric timbre. Perfect for horror stories, dark fantasy, psychological thrillers, and captivating narratives that transport the listener into the unknown. The voice comes across as intimate, controlled, and frighteningly calm, creating tension without ever having to raise its volume.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lola - Fantasy & LitRPG
de-frau-dunkel.description: An expressive & engaging female voice that brings immersive fantasy worlds and epic fiction to life. Perfect for LitRPG, sci-fi & fantasy audiobooks, progression fantasy, dark fantasy, video games, GameLit, NPCs, character voices, long-form & in-game narration, dual narration, and multicast audiobooks. From magical kingdoms, thrilling level-up adventures to action-packed battles and heroic quests, Lola delivers captivating performances that pull listeners into every character’s story.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Altáriel - Storyteller of the Light
de-frau-dunkel.description: Listen closely, for the world is changing. Altáriel is an ancient, velvety alto steeped in the epic melancholy of forgotten ages. She is the gray oracle between the light and the dark, delivering profound truths with an intimate, breathy closeness. Perfect for high-fantasy audiobooks, cinematic lore recaps, and immersive RPG narration. Let her whisper the secrets of the cosmos directly into your listeners' ears.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Freya Schönklang - Audiobook Narrator
de-frau-dunkel.description: A professional German female voice with a warm, resonant sound, rich tonal depth and a distinctive, sensual quality. Freya Schönklang combines literary elegance with psychological nuance, controlled intensity and emotional versatility, bringing characters and stories vividly to life. Ideal for fiction, romance, romantic suspense and narrative storytelling. For a more conversational style discover her companion voice, Marlena Lark.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Nadine – Whispering Witch of the Black Forest
de-frau-dunkel.description: German female voice for horror narration, witch characters and cinematic storytelling. Focus on tension, occult themes and atmospheric depth. Ideal for dark fantasy, suspense, mystery, Halloween content and immersive audio drama. Strong narrative presence with emotional control, perfect for haunting story worlds, sinister roles and high-quality story-driven productions.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Bettina - Gripping Crime Story Narrator
de-frau-dunkel.description: Controlled, expressive, and masterfully suspenseful — Bettina pulls listeners deep into dark narratives with a pacing that builds tension naturally and never lets it go. Her intriguing delivery makes every twist feel inevitable, and every silence feel loaded. Performed in German, built for suspense stories, crime fiction, psychological dramas, and dark thrillers. Ideal for audiobook studios, podcast networks, storytelling apps, and channels, building immersive German-language suspense experiences that audiences cannot stop listening to.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Maresi - Gritty Viennese Theatrical Alto
de-frau-dunkel.description: A deep, resonant alto with a heavy Viennese dialect and a lifetime of theater experience. Maresi transitions effortlessly from quiet, sardonic vulnerability to loud, commanding theatricality. Her voice features a slight rasp, natural breathing, and a uniquely dark, comedic undertone. Perfect for expressive storytelling, complex character dubbing, and narrative projects requiring a genuine, lived-in Austrian sound.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Maureen - Emotional and Expressive
de-frau-dunkel.description: A pleasant High German voice with no distinct dialect, ideal for stories and tales. The tone is dark, emotional, and expressive, bringing depth and feeling to narrative performances.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Céleste - French Fatale
de-frau-dunkel.description:
Speaks your language "avec l'accent", because not dropping her French is a matter of principle — et de style. Supremely arrogant and playful, filling the gaps with French phrases and theatrical sighs. 
Ideal for: villainesses, femmes fatales, unreliable narrators, audiobook antagonists, spy-thriller operatives, dark fairy-tale narrators, elegant-chaotic characters. Works best where the character knows she is being listened to and has opinions about it.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Evelyn Frost - Fantasy & Sci-Fi
de-frau-dunkel.description: A cool, confident and mature female voice for fantasy, sci-fi and LitRPG narration. With a strong, assured presence, precise delivery and controlled emotional intensity, she brings complex characters, immersive worlds, epic quests and futuristic adventures to life. Ideal for fantasy and sci-fi audiobooks, progression fantasy, game-inspired fiction, video games, NPCs, character dialogue, interactive storytelling, immersive world-building, dark fantasy and cinematic narration.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lola - Female Action Character
de-frau-dunkel.description: A powerful, commanding female voice with fierce energy, battle-hardened grit and cinematic intensity. Perfect for fantasy and RPG video games, Action LitRPG, epic fantasy, sci-fi, audiobooks, NPCs, and character voice acting. Brings fierce female warriors, huntresses, battle-hardened heroines, villains, assassins, necromancers, and formidable fantasy characters to life. From battle cries and commanding orders to dark magic and intense dialogue: this voice is bold, energetic and immersive.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Juliet - Dark Villain Character
de-frau-dunkel.description: Cold, controlled, and menacing. Built for villain monologues, antagonist dialogue, dark audio drama, video game boss characters, animated antagonists, mythological villains, and crime fiction narration for streaming platforms. A strong fit for audio platforms and for studios and game developers producing fiction, animation, and interactive DIALOGUE.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Morgaine - Deep, Dark & Dramatic Female
de-frau-dunkel.description: A rich, deep, and atmospheric female voice with a dark, resonant timbre. Mastered from classic dramatic literature, Morgaine delivers an intense, captivating, and sophisticated tone.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Lena - Deep, Dark & Haunting Storyteller
de-frau-dunkel.description: A deep, dark, atmospheric female voice with a haunting and mysterious tone. Ideal for horror stories, psychological thrillers, gothic fiction, supernatural tales, and suspenseful cinematic narration. Perfect for immersive storytelling that builds tension and intrigue.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Moriana - Dark, Seductive, Dangerous
de-frau-dunkel.description: Charismatic, velvety female voice with smooth elegance and wicked charm. Slightly raspy, mysterious and expressive, shifting effortlessly from sultry allure to icy authority. Blends sharp sarcasm, dark humor, and quiet menace. For fantasy audiobooks, villain monologues, cinematic storytelling, dark audio dramas, animation, video games, and immersive character dialogue. Ideal for evil queens, mysterious sorceresses, sensual villains, femme fatales, cunning antagonists, and complex anti-heroines.

de-frau-dunkel.name: Yasmine - Dark Fantasy & Epic Narration
de-frau-dunkel.description: A dramatic, narrative voice ideal for high fantasy storytelling, epic scale descriptions, and mythical adventures.

de-tief.name: Peter Hartlapp – Tiefe Podcaststimme
de-tief.description:
A unique, deep, and resonant male voice with strong recognition value.
Ideal for podcasts, interviews, and long-form formats where presence, calmness, and authenticity are important.

Warm, confident, and compelling – this voice conveys conversations, thoughts, and stories with natural authority.

de-tief.name: Markus Kästler - Rich, Masculine & Confident
de-tief.description:
When your message needs to hit with maximum force, you need Markus Kästler. 
This German advertising professional, brings years of top-tier industry experience directly to your project. From automotive giants like VW and broadcasting powerhouse ARD, to elite tech firms and corporate law practices - heavyweights trust this voice to anchor their biggest campaigns. Now, it's your turn.

de-tief.name: Kadir C. - Street Philosopher
de-tief.description: Für die Momente nach Mitternacht. Ein tiefer, sanfter, aber gefährlich klingender Bariton. Perfekt für atmosphärische Vlogs, Late-Night-Gedanken oder stylische Street-Edits. Klingt nach teurem Parfüm und harten Straßen – die ultimative Stimme für ästhetischen Urban-Content.

de-tief.name: Quang Tien - Audiobook
de-tief.description: Warm and natural Vietnamese male voice with a calm, confident, and professional tone. Suitable for narration, videos, educational content, documentaries, commercials, and storytelling.

de-tief.name: Quang Tiến - News Narrator
de-tief.description: A professional male voice with a warm, clear, natural, and engaging tone. Ideal for news reporting, current affairs, documentaries, storytelling, and narration. The delivery is calm, confident, articulate, and expressive, with natural pacing and clear pronunciation.

de-tief.name: Quang Tien - Sports Commentator
de-tief.description: A professional Vietnamese male sports commentator voice with clear pronunciation, energetic delivery, natural emotion, and engaging intonation. Perfect for football commentary, basketball highlights, sports news, and exciting match recaps.

de-tief.name: Anant - Natural, Calm and Sympathetic
de-tief.description:
Anant’s voice is grounded, natural, and convincingly real.

This voice is particularly effective in Hindi for Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets, where relatability and clarity matter most. It’s optimized for everyday customer communication across inbound support, EMI reminders, IVR flows, and onboarding journeys.

Perfect for BFSI companies. Anant’s voice helps humanize automation.

de-tief.name: Rohit - Friendly, Helpful and Clear
de-tief.description: Rohit T brings a warm, approachable tone that makes customers feel instantly heard and supported. His voice balances empathy and clarity—ideal for banking, fintech, and e-commerce support. Designed for tier-1 customer queries, feedback resolution, and real-time human-like assistance, Rohit T’s voice fits well on customer conversation platforms. Its natural friendliness makes it ideal for brands seeking to humanize digital CX through voice.

de-tief.name: Jeet – Regional Customer Care, Bihari
de-tief.description: Jeet delivers a cool, friendly, & professional tone with a natural North Indian Hindi influence, including a subtle Bihari warmth that feels familiar & grounded. His delivery builds comfort quickly while maintaining clarity & structure, making customer care feel relatable rather than scripted. Ideal for customer care, service assistance, onboarding calls, and regional support communication. Suited for banks, telecom, e-com, & fintech brands serving Tier 2 & Tier 3 markets across North India.

de-tief.name: Raghu - Polished Regional Banking Agent
de-tief.description: Raghu carries a polished yet distinctly regional Hindi voice — authoritative enough to command trust, familiar enough to feel local. Built for cooperative banks, microfinance institutions, and public sector lenders building Hindi voice agents for Tier 2 and 3 markets. Ideal for KYC outreach, loan status updates, EMI reminders, and account servicing calls where a neutral voice feels too distant and a raw dialect feels unprofessional.

de-tief.name: Connery - Premium Real Estate SDR
de-tief.description: Polished, authoritative, and built to close. Connery sounds like the agent who's already done the homework — his American delivery carries the kind of quiet confidence that makes buyers trust the advice before they question it. Built for luxury real estate pitches, property sales flows, developer brand films, IVR walkthroughs, and high-end listings where the voice signals the tier of the property.

de-tief.name: Hemant M - Bhojpuri Sales & Telecalling
de-tief.description: Persuasive, warm, and street-smart, this read closes without ever sounding pushy — the tone of a local who genuinely knows the customer and talks like one. In Bhojpuri, it suits outbound sales calls, loan and insurance follow-ups, product pitches, lead qualification, appointment setting, and payment reminders. A strong fit for outbound bots, CRM voice integrations, and telecalling platforms serving tier-2 towns and rural markets.

de-tief.name: Armaan - Local Outbound Sales Agent
de-tief.description: Confident, persuasive & warm, this voice sounds less like a call centre and more like someone from your own neighbourhood. Built for product pitches, objection handling, follow-up calls, lead qualification, appointment booking, and payment nudges that need a human touch. A strong fit for outbound sales bots, telecalling systems, and CRM voice integrations, and for BFSI, insurance, and D2C teams selling into tier-2 and local markets.

de-tief.name: Guddu - Sweet Ecomm Order & Returns Bot
de-tief.description: Guddu brings a sweet, young Hindi-Hinglish energy that makes ecommerce support feel like talking to a helpful friend. Built for order tracking, return requests, COD confirmations, and delivery updates — his natural tone keeps Tier 2 and 3 city customers engaged and at ease. Perfect for ecommerce platforms, quick commerce apps, and D2C brands. Developers love him for post-order flows where a warm, relatable voice directly improves customer satisfaction scores.

de-tief.name: Prafull
de-tief.description: High-bass, studio recorded voice designed for top-tier audio description and narration.
